{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any commas in the revenue strings
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Show the first few of those
print(sales[has_commas]['revenue'].head())"}
